exposure: Enhanced Recovery After Surgery (ERAS) protocol (restricted fasting, oral carbohydrate solution, intraoperative multimodal analgesia, PONV prophylaxis, early mother-baby contact and breastfeeding encouragement)
outcome: Maternal preoperative and postoperative fasting duration
Maternal postoperative first flatus and mobilization times
Umbilical cord blood gas analysis (pH, pO2)
cohort: 450 ASA II-III parturients at >= 18 years of age scheduled for elective cesarean section under spinal anesthesia were included.
finding: The ERAS group demonstrated significantly better maternal recovery in ObsQoR-11T scores, shorter fasting, flatus, mobilization, length of stay, less pain and rescue analgesic use, and lower PONV incidence, alongside improved neonatal nutrition and breastfeeding compared to standard care.
